title: Lent me a feather
author: Rumpa Ray-Ghosh
text:
You perched on the
Stony clusters alongside
The pavement stretch,
There the warm billows
Roll and peck the shore.
Migrated from faraway
You were in the quest of life,
Yet you lent me a feather
To ease my flight beyond
The horizon of light and shadow.
Molded my wings with hope
To endure the trial of tempest,
Gifted me a reason to weave stories
To be translated solely by the waves.
